svg.title: Results: rail vs mrc-style SRv6, 11 runs
svg.text: Results - 32 QPs from srv1 to srv2, median of 11 runs
1000 packets per second per QP, so 1 lost packet = 1 ms of that QP. mrc = MRC-style SRv6: static uSID paths, host sprays, 50 ms probes
every QP keeps 15 of 16 paths, dead one dropped after 195 ms
16 QPs (14-18) dead for the whole 10 s
every QP keeps 15 of 16 paths, dead one dropped after 193 ms
leaf reroutes at once, nothing lost
~12 per QP per flap, the switches don't react, probes do
4 QPs of rail 0 dead ~14 s: 10 s fault + BGP
every QP keeps 14 of 16 paths, dropped after 197 ms
lost a few packets, kept running
which QPs are hit in rail depends on the ECMP hash and changes per run, the count is what's measured
